variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.notes: Metadata only; the credential-bearing pooled URL is never stored in Git.

variables.name: DIRECT_URL
variables.notes: Must be independent from DATABASE_URL and never stored in Git.

variables.name: RESPONSEOS_DATABASE_IDENTITY
variables.activationEffect: Binds non-secret database identity evidence to exact environment variable revisions.
variables.notes: The environment-specific attestation is regenerated from readback; it is not copied.

variables.name: CLERK_SECRET_KEY
variables.notes: Staging uses a development-instance credential; Production must use a separate Production instance.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
variables.notes: Client-exposed by design, but environment-specific and never copied to Production.

variables.name: CLERK_WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.activationEffect: Verifies Clerk webhook signatures before mutation.
variables.notes: Bound to the staging webhook endpoint and Clerk development instance.

variables.name: AJ_DIGITAL_CLERK_ORG_ID
variables.activationEffect: Selects the AJ Digital control organization.
variables.notes: Production ownership must be explicitly resolved against its Production Clerk instance.

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
variables.activationEffect: Defines the browser-visible non-production base URL.
variables.notes: Production must use its independently approved Production URL.

variables.name: RESPONSEOS_REQUIRE_AUTH
variables.activationEffect: Forces hosted authentication to fail closed.
variables.notes: The enabled semantic must match Production; no secret value is involved.

variables.name: NEON_API_KEY
variables.activationEffect: Allows protected workflow readback of the governed Neon control plane.
variables.notes: Workflow-only; never passed to Vercel or application runtime.

variables.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
variables.activationEffect: Allows protected workflow control-plane readback and separately authorized deployment.

variables.name: VERCEL_ORG_ID
variables.activationEffect: Binds workflow operations to the approved Vercel team.
variables.notes: Identity metadata only; equality with Production is allowed by policy.

variables.name: VERCEL_PROJECT_ID
variables.activationEffect: Binds workflow operations to the staging project.
variables.notes: Production must use a different project identity.

variables.name: VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET
variables.activationEffect: Allows scoped workflow smoke through Deployment Protection.
variables.notes: Must be project-scoped and independently created for Production.
